page.title: Forwarding setup
page.subtitle: Your forwarding address and the Gmail steps that send recruiter mail to it — what arrives lands in the Inbox for review
page.unexpectedError: Could not reach the email connection

stage.unconfiguredHint: This server has no inbound mail zone, so no address can be issued — set MAIL_INBOUND_DOMAIN and restart the API
stage.unissuedHint: Take an address of your own, then forward recruiter mail to it from your mail client
stage.pausedHint: The address is still yours, but nothing arriving at it is read
stage.waitingHint: The address is live and has taken nothing yet — forward a message to see it arrive
stage.receivingHint: Mail forwarded here is read and matched against your applications

address.title: Your forwarding address
address.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the address and copy it by hand
address.replaceBody: The address you have stops taking mail, and the forwarding rule in your mail client has to be pointed at the new one

setup.title: Connecting Gmail
setup.unexpectedError: Could not read the Gmail setup

apply.title: Apply with an address of your own
apply.unset: Gmail delivers {{email}} to your inbox like your own address — the filter forwards only mail sent to it, so apply with it
apply.set: The extension fills {{email}} into application forms, and the filter forwards only mail sent to it

forward.title: Connect forwarding
forward.body: In Gmail's forwarding settings, add {{address}} as a forwarding address — Gmail mails it a confirmation, which shows up here
forward.readd: Nothing after a minute? Gmail has no resend button — remove the address under Forwarding and add it again to get a new confirmation
forward.linkFor: Gmail asks to confirm forwarding from {{account}} — open its page and click Confirm
forward.link: Gmail asks to confirm forwarding — open its page and click Confirm
forward.codeFor: Gmail's code for {{account}} — enter it under Forwarding and click Verify
forward.code: Gmail's confirmation code — enter it under Forwarding and click Verify
forward.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the code and copy it by hand

filter.title: Create the filter
filter.waiting: Set the address for applications first — the filter forwards only mail sent to it
filter.body: Gmail opens with the filter filled in: click "Create filter", tick "Forward it to", choose {{address}} and click "Create filter" again — Gmail lists the address once forwarding is confirmed
filter.paste: Or paste it into Gmail's "Has the words" yourself — it names only this address, so it never needs copying again
filter.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the query and copy it by hand

setup.manual: Mail to any other address stays in Gmail — forward a message by hand to {{address}} and it is read the same way
setup.privacy: Only what you forward is read — a message is kept as its sender, subject, date and the line that decided the verdict, not as its body
